carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features displaying a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with high pixel intensity on the superior edge and lower intensity values (shadowing) on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Five vertical branchial slits are visible on the anterior portion of the flank, characterized by deep-shadow pixel regions between structural folds.
